evidence: Migration 0120_outreach_health_id_unclaimed.sql (placeholder; releases right after 0119, which it extends) plus its runtime-grants.sql block. WHAT IT DOES: a Health ID can be created at an outreach for a person with no email (and possibly no phone), with every guard of 0119 (campaign membership checked in the command, not redacted, not a sealed demo or QA group, not suspended, 18 or over, one Health ID per registration). The patient (name, sex, phone if any; no date of birth) and its Health ID identifier are created with NO account and no contact-verified assurance, so nobody can sign in until the person claims it (the claim flow comes after the campaign). 0119's identity.outreach_registration_health_ids gains created_via ('email' default, 'unclaimed') and possible_duplicate; account_id and challenge_id become nullable, null exactly for an unclaimed Health ID (check constraints). New owner-only identity.outreach_health_id_claims holds the claim code's keyed HMAC only (180 days, 5 attempts). A phone already on a Health ID is refused; with no phone, an active patient with the same name and sex is flagged for review, never refused. identity.outreach_health_id_counts gives counts only for the platform admin; identity.outreach_registration_health_ids_for is replaced to also answer created_via. Audit rows carry ids and flags only. Existing records stay 'email' (post-check).
